name: Image Placer
desc: Add pictures from your folders or SD card to any note. The picture lands selected, ready to move or resize. Crop it (free, original, 1:1, 4:3, 3:4, 16:9, 9:16), round its corners and rotate it from the lasso menu. Frame it with a border: a solid, dashed or dotted line in four greys, or washi tape in 31 patterns on the corners, across the top or all the way round. Optionally keep pictures on their own Images layer. Works fully offline: no internet access, and it never changes your files.
author: 82deg
